_comment: Company contact details used in the Footer and Contact page. Everything here is FACTUAL and shared by all three markets. `location` is keyed by WRITING SYSTEM (en/ar), not by market: the Cairo address reads identically in /ar-eg and /ar-sa, so storing it per market would be duplication rather than localization. Select it with getContentScript() from src/lib/marketLocale.ts. NOTE: the structured data in index.html (the <script type=application/ld+json> blocks) and the social links there must be updated by hand to match, that file is static HTML and cannot read this JSON.
